title: Advocate
desc: Three girls who escape molestation but are charged with murder must prove their innocence with the help of a lawyer who is an alcoholic.

title: Black
desc: Five young men form a vigilante group in order to find and murder corrupt people in society. Soon, their actions escalate to such an extent that a senior police officer begins to investigate them.

title: Solillada Saradara
desc: Krishna, a ferry driver, is about to marry Rukmini, the love of his life. However, things take a turn when a landlord's daughter falls for him.

title: Praana
desc: A millionaire who is a quadriplegic hires an ex-convict as his caretaker. As they spend time together, they begin to empathise with each other and learn valuable life lessons.

title: Neelakanta
desc: A man is obedient towards his mother and overcomes all the obstacles life throws his way. Unfortunately, the matriarch disapproves of his marriage and causes problems for him.
